Step by step

How it works

From your first message until you are back home, you have one contact person who speaks your language. Here is the whole journey, with no surprises.

Free consultation

From the airport to your door

I am with you at every stage. This is what your journey looks like, step by step.

1 / 5

  1. Consultation

    You message me on WhatsApp and send photos or test results. We talk, by video too if you like.

    I choose the clinic and the doctor. Sometimes I also arrange a video consultation with the doctor. You get a treatment plan and a quote. The decision is yours; I never push.

  2. Arrival

    Once we agree on dates, I book your hotel and transfers. You buy your ticket and send me the flight number.

    I wait for you in the arrivals hall. From that moment you are not alone in Istanbul.

  3. Treatment

    I am with you at the clinic and interpret every conversation with the doctor. You can ask anything.

    I explain every instruction and every document before you sign anything.

  4. Your stay

    Throughout your stay I am available 24 hours a day. We go to check-ups together.

    If you come with someone close to you, I look after them too.

  5. Going home

    Your transfer to the airport is arranged. You have your aftercare advice in your language.

    We stay in touch after you get home. If you have questions, I pass them on to the doctor.

What I take care of

From your first message until you are back home, you have one person to contact.

  • Choosing the clinic and doctor

    I choose the doctor for each patient individually, based on their needs.

  • Consultation before you travel

    We talk on WhatsApp or by video. Before you leave, you know the plan and the price.

  • Airport pick-up

    I wait for you in the arrivals hall. From that moment you are not alone in Istanbul.

  • Hotel and transfers

    I book your hotel and arrange every journey: airport, hotel, clinic.

  • Interpreting at the clinic

    I am present at every conversation with the doctor and interpret it.

  • 24/7 support

    Throughout your stay you can call or message me at any time.

  • In touch after you return

    When you are back home, we stay in touch.

  • Free for you

    You don't pay for my help. You only pay for treatment and your stay.

Free for you

My work is paid for by the clinic I work with. You do not pay for my help.

  • Consultation and first quote
  • Choosing the clinic and doctor
  • Hotel booking and transfers
  • Airport pick-up
  • Interpreting during treatment
  • 24/7 support and contact after you return

What you pay for

You only pay for what you use. You know all the costs before you travel.

  • Treatment, as quoted before you travel
  • Hotel
  • Flights
  • Meals and personal expenses

What to prepare for the consultation

A few photos and details are enough for a first quote. Choose your treatment.

  • 01

    Dentistry

    • A panoramic X-ray of your teeth, if you have one
    • Photos of your smile from the front and side
    • A few words about what you want to change
    • Chronic conditions and medication you take
    • Your preferred travel dates
  • 02

    Plastic surgery

    • Photos of the area you want to change
    • Height and weight
    • Chronic conditions, medication and allergies
    • Previous operations
    • Your expectations, in your own words
  • 03

    Hair transplant

    • Photos of your head: front, top, back and sides
    • How long you have been losing hair
    • Chronic conditions and medication
    • Whether you have had a transplant before
    • Your preferred travel dates
  • 04

    Bariatric surgery

    • Height and current weight
    • Conditions such as diabetes or high blood pressure
    • Medication you take
    • Previous abdominal surgery
    • Test results, if you have any
  • 05

    Eye surgery

    • Your current prescription
    • Whether you wear contact lenses, and which
    • Eye conditions and general health conditions
    • Medication you take
    • Your preferred travel dates
